mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over the prior three months signals a tightening monetary regime, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% per month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) during periods when this trigger is met in at least 5 out of the last 10 tightening episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5% for two consecutive months indicates a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) during periods when the trigger is met in at least 5 out of the last 10 instances.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent and sustained decline in both personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 6 out of 10 such episodes where both proxies decline for two quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals a broad-based supply-side weakness, which increases input costs and reduces output, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month moving average for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 5 out of the last 10 such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 2% combined with a concurrent rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3% for two months signals a monetary policy lag and impending policy tightening, which increases uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% AND CPIAUCSL > 3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 4 out of the last 8 such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth above +200k per month for three consecutive months, while the unemployment rate remains below 5%, signals an overheating labor market that will soon prompt restrictive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200000 for 3 consecutive months AND UNRATE < 5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 5 out of the last 10 such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent month-over-month decline in real personal savings (RSAFS) below its 12-month average for six consecutive months indicates reduced household buffer capacity, which increases sensitivity to income shocks and reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month moving average for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 4 out of the last 8 such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous and persistent decline in both industrial production (INDPRO) and personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for three consecutive months signals a synchronized deterioration in both supply and demand, which amplifies recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 5 out of the last 10 such episodes.
